description: Fetch an actor's current X25519 prekey bundle (identity key, signed prekey, one-time-prekey pool) for full X3DH E2E session establishment.

identityKey.description: aozora extension: base64url X25519 public identity key

signedPreKey.description: aozora extension: base64url X25519 public signed prekey

signedPreKeySig.description: aozora extension: base64url Ed25519 signature over signedPreKey

oneTimePreKeys.description: aozora extension: base64url X25519 one-time-prekey pool (see registerPrekeys — a pool, not per-fetch-consumed). May be empty/absent.
